verdict.rationale: Vercel's AI Gateway (vercel-docs-2) provides single-endpoint access to hundreds of models with budgets, fallbacks, and monitoring, matching the 'single call, no GPU/capacity management' claim, and Vercel's global edge network implies global distribution. However, there's no explicit evidence of global latency-routing specifically for inference calls, no independent benchmark or hands-on confirmation of the 'globally' aspect, and no detail on capacity planning guarantees. Missing for 10: independent verification of global low-latency routing for inference, explicit capacity/scaling guarantees, and hands-on confirmation of the gateway's performance under load.
